posts.title: A Little Determinism
posts.description: How do I get an agent to behave like I would, without me telling it to? Most of the predictability in Junior came from an unlikely candidate: a man-in-the-middle egress proxy.

posts.title: Building an Intern
posts.description: Junior is the open-source Slack agent I've been building at Sentry for the last four months. It seemed easy: put an agent in Slack, give it tools, ship it. This is the story of how it was anything but.

posts.title: A Bigger Toolbox for MCP
posts.description: Search and execute primitives are how MCP gets useful at scale. You can expose thousands of capabilities without dumping every tool definition into the model context.
